title: Dozy Won't Wake Up
reason: Retain the decodable repeated structure while correcting dialogue punctuation and reducing awkward repetition.

pages.1: It was morning in Sunny Hollow. Everyone was up. Everyone except Dozy.
pages.2: "Wake up, Dozy!" called Bouncy. Dozy did not wake up.
pages.3: "Wake up, Dozy!" called Zippy. Dozy did not wake up.
pages.4: "Wake up, Dozy!" called Honky. Dozy did not wake up.
pages.5: "We have a problem," said Bossy. "We need Dozy for the picnic!"
pages.6: Chompy had an idea. Chompy found the biggest, yummiest lunch in Sunny Hollow.
pages.7: Dozy sniffed. He opened one eye. "Is that... lunch?" he asked.
pages.8: Dozy got up. "I was just resting my eyes," he said. His eyes were already closing again.
